summary.intent: Plan and execute CipherBox phase 68.2 (SDK-owned read chain and resolved folder listings) end-to-end using the GSD plan-phase and execute-phase workflows, and in parallel set up an isolated git worktree so phase 69 (Rust FUSE/WinFsp) could be planned independently.
summary.outcome: Phase 68.2 was fully researched, scoped (D-07 full-boundary decision locked), pattern-mapped, and planned into 12 plans across 7 waves, which passed the plan-checker and all coverage gates; execution began sequentially on the main tree and completed waves 1-3 (SDK read-gate, ResolvedChild listing API, write-path facade) with spot-checks passing, while wave 3's second plan (desync e2e spec) was dispatched. A separate worktree for phase 69 was created off origin/main and handed off to the user to kick off in a new session.

repo: gsd-tools commit helper can report `commit_failed` even when the commit actually landed in git log — a known false-negative that must be verified with `git log` rather than trusted at face value.
The `gap-analysis.plan-post` non-blocking gate's JSON `rendered` field can contain control characters that break naive parsing; run the underlying check directly instead.

REQUIREMENTS.md checkbox tracking is fragile across multi-wave phases: executors can prematurely mark a requirement `[x]` complete when only part of its acceptance criteria (e.g. deleting legacy services) is satisfied in an early wave — plan-03's executor caught and reverted this for SDK-READ-04, but SDK-READ-01/02 slipped through and had to be manually reverted to `[ ]` by the orchestrator.
`git fetch` cannot reach GitHub from a sandboxed session (no network), but a locally cached `origin/main` ref can still be valid/current if it matches the fork-base of a same-day branch.

Phase 69 (Rust/Desktop FUSE/WinFsp) has a roadmap-declared 'design-mirroring' (not code) dependency on phase 68.2 — worktrees based on origin/main won't carry 68.2's CONTEXT/RESEARCH docs, but they remain readable cross-branch via `git show <branch>:<path>` since `.git` is shared.

code.finding: ROT-07 anti-rollback gate (`RotationHighWater.enforceResolved`) added to root resolve path in plan 68.2-01.
`enforceResolved` gate also added inside `dfsFindFolder`'s child loop; pre-existing write-path gate remains at line 1156.

`resolveChildren` docstring documents an intentional security tradeoff: unverifiable sibling children are skipped (availability cost) rather than surfaced with stale/unverified content, because the parent folder is already gated before this runs and re-entering any child re-triggers the gate.

workflow: For pnpm monorepos, prefer sequential wave execution on the main tree over parallel git worktrees when most waves are single-plan — worktree executors each need their own `pnpm install`, which is expensive overhead that sequential execution avoids while preserving correctness (same-wave plans are file-disjoint by planner design).
Before dispatching any worktree-based executor, verify `worktree.baseRef` — a `fresh` (origin/main) default would silently exclude newly-committed PLAN.md files that only exist on HEAD.

When a user requests a parallel worktree for independent work, use plain `git worktree add` (not an EnterWorktree-style tool) so the orchestrator's own shell stays in the original checkout driving the in-progress phase.

After each wave's executor reports completion, spot-check commits/SUMMARY and independently re-run the security-relevant acceptance tests rather than trusting the self-reported result, especially for security-critical/foundational waves.

friction: gsd-tools commit helper's `commit_failed` false-negative required manual git log verification multiple times during planning and execution.
Post-planning gap-analysis gate output contained control characters that broke the initial parse, requiring a direct re-run of the check.
`git fetch` failed outright from the sandboxed session, forcing reliance on a possibly-stale cached `origin/main` ref (which turned out to still be valid).
Executors across waves 1-3 inconsistently marked REQUIREMENTS.md checkboxes complete before all acceptance criteria were actually met, requiring manual correction and an extra commit.
open_items: D-03's poll-invalidation leg has no dedicated automated test (only grep-level coverage in plan 09) — logged as a todo (`2026-07-06-d03-poll-invalidation-lacks-automated-coverage.md`) for follow-up gap closure.

Phase 68.2 execution still has waves 4-7 remaining (web rewire + store collapse, off-path pockets for BYO-pinning/auth-bootstrap, deletion of orphaned services + D-07 grep gate, and the SealedChildRef mirror revert + full web-e2e gate).
